rank_definition: (average_rank - 0.5) / finite_eligible_count - 0.5, within signal date; missing/ineligible remain NaN
preprocessing_fit: fold training main samples only; per-feature median fill, then mean/population-std scaling
label: unchanged y_excess_5d; strict main label, no target clipping or ranking
weighting: equal stock-date rows for loss; equal OOF dates for selection
ridge_alpha_definition: alpha = number_of_fold_training_rows * lambda; minimize mean_squared_error + lambda * sum(coef**2), unpenalized intercept
selection: highest mean of all inner OOF date Rank ICs within each model/representation; exact ties choose first grid entry
constant_prediction_policy: abort and investigate; never replace undefined IC with zero
baseline: raw momentum_20, positive direction, missing filled with fold-training median
